SEASONS
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fiddle with single nights, define four broad seasons and let them carry the pricing forward. Override only when the calendar — an exhibition opening, a regional holiday, the long quiet of February — calls for it.

Four moods, plotted across the year.

● High — Summer	May 1 – Aug 31	4 nights	€520	€560	Edit
